Conditions

  • Mind Flayer Form

    • Affected entity has embraced ceremorphosis and become a mind flayer.

  • Permanent Mind Sanctuary

    • While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

Features

  • Ability Drain

    Once per turn, when you make an Attack Roll, the attack reduces that target's corresponding Ability by 1. The reduced ability score cannot be decreased lower than 1.

  • Charm

    Can charm an attacking enemy, preventing further attacks until their next turn.

  • Cull the Weak

    When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

  • Favourable Beginnings

    First attack roll or ability check against any target gains proficiency bonus.

  • Luck of the Far Realms

    Once per Long Rest, you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit.

  • Permanent Mind Sanctuary

    You can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

  • Psionic Backlash

    When an enemy casts a spell, can use a reaction to deal 1d4 Psychic per spell level.

  • Psionic Dominance

    When an enemy within 18 m (60 ft) targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you can use your reaction to nullify the spell.

A full-illithid is a character who has undergone complete  ceremorphosis and become a mind flayer.

Overview

This option only becomes available after travelling to the Astral Plane during the quest Confront the Elder Brain.

In order to transform, the player character must offer to do so while in dialogue with the  Emperor or  Orpheus once they have reached the Astral Plane after travelling to the Morphic Pool. If  Karlach is brought along, she also offers to transform. It is not necessary for the player character or Karlach to have accepted the  Astral-Touched Tadpole and become a partial-illithid to become a full-illithid.

While all party members may become partial-illithid, only the player character, Orpheus or Karlach may undergo the full transformation.

Undoing the transformation is only possible for  Gale as an Origin character. If he completes ⁠The Wizard of Waterdeep and hands over the  Crown of Karsus to  Mystra, the goddess of magic transforms Gale back into his human self to show her gratitude.

Changes

The player character and Karlach still have access to their previous set of abilities and proficiencies. However, ability scores, race and type change (see info box). Ability score improvements previously gained through the Ability Improvement feat are not retained (e.g., the character will still have 12 dexterity even if they previously improved it by 2 using the feat). However, improvements gained through the Mirror of Loss and  Auntie Ethel's Hair will persist and add on top of the illithid's base abilities.

A transformed Orpheus has slightly different stats, and only has access to his illithid powers.

Conditions

  •  Mind Flayer Form
  •  Permanent Mind Sanctuary

New abilities

After becoming a full-illthid, the illithid power tree becomes locked, [note 1] however most[note 2] abilities, or upgraded versions of abilities, are gained, as well as some new ones:

  •  Levitate (Illithid Power)
  •  Tentacle Whip (Full-illithid)
  •  Extract Brain (Full-illithid)
  •  Strengthened Force Tunnel
  •  Fierce Perilous Stakes
  •  Nebulous Black Hole
  •  Synaptic Consumption
  •  Augmented Shield of Thralls
  •  Potent Concentrated Blast
  •  Fracture Psyche (Full-illithid)

And the full-illithid upgrade of Mind Sanctuary:

  •  Permanent Mind Sanctuary

Old abilities

If the character did not already have the following powers, they are unlocked:

  •  Displacer Beast Shape
  •  Stage Fright
  •  Psionic Overload
  •  Mind Blast
  •  Mind Sanctuary
  •  Transfuse Health

And the following passives, if they did not already have them:

  •  Ability Drain
  •  Charm
  •  Cull the Weak
  •  Favourable Beginnings
  •  Luck of the Far Realms
  •  Psionic Backlash
  •  Psionic Dominance
